how_to_apply: Obtain and print the prescribed application form included at the end of the official advertisement.
Fill in the form in block letters, mentioning the relevant discipline and qualification, apprenticeship and experience details.

Clearly superscribe the envelope with the prescribed wording below, inserting the trade or discipline.
Forward the application by post to the address below so it reaches the office within the specified 21-day period.

content_sections.heading: Ordnance Factory Badmal Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The engagement is on a contract basis at Ordnance Factory Badmal, Balangir, Odisha. Candidates looking for other government jobs in Odisha can also check current recruitment opportunities.

rows.details: Ordnance Factory Badmal, Munitions India Limited
One year; extendable up to four years including initial period

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: Employment News publication 26.11.2026. Last date for receipt of applications 21 days from publication in Employment News. Document verification and interview Call letters will be communicated by post and email.

content_sections.heading: Post-Wise Vacancy Distribution
content_sections.text: Chemical – 2 posts Electrical & Instrumentation – 2 posts Each discipline represents 50% of the four advertised vacancies. Total: 4 posts All advertised vacancies are unreserved. No separate vacancies are shown for OBC (NCL), SC, ST, EWS or ex-servicemen. Vacancy numbers may change depending on factory requirements.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants may also check other Diploma government jobs matching their qualifications. Relevant apprenticeship in ordnance factories under Munitions India Limited, factories manufacturing or handling ammunition and explosives, or other factories is considered under the notified preference order. Candidates without apprenticeship may also apply but will be considered only if suitable eligible apprentices in the relevant discipline are unavailable. Selected candidates without apprenticeship in ammunition and explosives must undergo the necessary safety and technical security training before deployment. General candidates must be between 18 and 30 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications. The supplied age-limit clause does not specify separate category-wise relaxation figures.

rows.qualification: B.E./B.Tech./Diploma in Chemical Engineering or B.Sc. with Chemistry as one of the major subjects.
B.E./B.Tech./Diploma in the relevant trade or discipline.

content_sections.heading: Salary and Contract Duration
content_sections.text: First year ₹36,000 Second year ₹37,080 Third year ₹38,192 Fourth year ₹39,338 Year-wise basic pay, subject to continuation of engagement. Remuneration is calculated at 1/30 of the relevant pay plus dearness allowance for eight hours of work per day. IDA and HRA (where company quarters are unavailable) apply as prescribed. EPF, applicable employee compensation and bonus provisions are also specified. Unauthorized absence attracts proportionate deductions. The initial contract is for one year and may be extended up to a maximum of four years, including the initial period, based on factory requirements and individual performance. There is no right to permanent absorption. The notice provides for earned and casual leave subject to its conditions and applicable maternity benefits; regular employee benefits such as promotion and LTC/LTA are not available.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Ordnance Factory Badmal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Ordnance Factory Badmal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 2 Graduate/Diploma Project Engineer (Chemical), 2 Graduate/Diploma Project Engineer (Electrical & Instrumentation).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Ordnance Factory Badmal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application Form attached to the advertisement (pages 9 to 11 of the PDF)) and send it to The Chief General Manager, Ordnance Factory Badmal, PO - Badmal, District - Balangir, PIN - 767070, Odisha, by post, to reach by 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All Candidates: NIL.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 18 and 30 years for General Candidates (as on the closing date of receipt of application).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 1st Yr. Rs.36000 2nd Yr. Rs.37080 3rd Yr. Rs.38192 4th Yr. Rs.39338 (Supervisory) for Graduate/Diploma Project Engineer (Chemical), 1st Yr. Rs.36000 2nd Yr. Rs.37080 3rd Yr. Rs.38192 4th Yr. Rs.39338 (Supervisory) for Graduate/Diploma Project Engineer (Electrical & Instrumentation).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Chemical: B.E/B.Tech./Diploma in Chemical Engineering OR B.Sc Graduate with Chemistry as one of the major subjects. Electrical & Instrumentation: B.E/B.Tech./Diploma in relevant trade/discipline. Apprenticeship in relevant trade/discipline gets preference; candidates without apprenticeship may also apply. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only citizens of India may apply. Selected candidates without apprenticeship in ammunition and explosives are deployed only after safety and technical scrutiny training by Ordnance Factory Badmal. Medium of Personal Interaction/Interview: English or Hindi.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after the closing date are summarily rejected. Applications not meeting eligibility criteria and terms of the advertisement are summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting by cut-off percentage in Degree/Diploma marks. Document Verification. Personal Interaction/Interview. Merit list: 85% Degree/Diploma marks and 15% Interaction/Interview.
